summary_en: 7,000,000 shares (1.32% of S/O) to be acquired at closing price of ¥3,413/share via ToSTNeT-3 block trade on 2026-08-10 at 08:45 JST. Total acquisition cost capped at ¥23.89 billion. Results to be disclosed upon trade completion. Seller includes Tokio Marine & Nichido Fire Insurance divesting full holdings.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares via off-hours block trades (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2026, Shizuoka Financial Group announced a specific block-trade execution of its previously authorized share buyback programme. The company will acquire up to 7.0 million treasury shares (1.32% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury) via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on 10 August 2026 at 08:45 JST, using the closing price of ¥3,413 per share established on 7 August. The total acquisition cost is capped at ¥23.89 billion. Results will be disclosed immediately after trade completion. The transaction is conducted under articles of incorporation provisions authorised under Companies Act section 165(2). Notably, Tokio Marine & Nichido Fire Insurance has indicated intent to divest its complete holdings of the company's shares as the counterparty to this block purchase. The broader board-authorised programme (announced 6 August) permits up to 10.0 million shares (1.88% of S/O) for ¥30 billion via various market methods through 18 September 2026; today's block trade represents a single execution within that authorisation.
